reviews.reasons: EXECUTABLE is right: the single member cop_ebd0bbebaf434f9ea99e has every link established by EVIDENCE on its own card — $24 is what these storefront buyers actually paid (41 sales in 30 days), conversion 41/1,640 = 2.5% measured on the same page and population, traffic steady at 1,500-1,700/month for four months, automatic Brain delivery, 10% marketplace fee and 10-day fund release. Arithmetic recomputed: 1,640/30 = 54.7 visitors/day x 2.5% = 1.37 sales/day. 28 sales x $24 = $672 gross, less 28 x $2.40 = $67.20 withheld fee = $604.80 settled >= $600. Sales through day 35 still settle by day 45: 54.7 x 35 = 1,913 visitors, so 28 sales need only a 1.46% rate against the measured 2.5% (~48 expected). $0 capital and $0 exposure: the fee is withheld from released funds. Owner hours fit: delivery is automatic with no owner time per sale; even reading the card's humanHours 0.2 as per sale, 28 x 0.2 = 5.6 h fits the 6 h window cap. Excluding the $150 kitchen walk-through is correct: one 8-hour owner visit already exceeds 6 hours.
findings: Settled-cash margin at exactly 28 sales is only $4.80; the plan's safety comes from continuing sales to day 35, not from the 28 figure — the operator should not stop selling at 28.
The card's humanHours 0.2 conflicts with 'no owner time per sale'; it does not bind at this volume but should be reconciled on the card.
Ledger lumps sales into 10-day blocks settled at block end — conservative, consistent with the 10-day release.
